title: Transposition of a convolution against a compactly supported test function (Fubini)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and E = ℝⁿ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) with Lebesgue measure. Let F : E → ℝ be integrable, and let ρ, h : E → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Use Mathlib's scalar convolution (a * b)(x) := ∫ a(t) b(x − t) dt, i.e. convolution a b (lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume, and put ρ̌(t) := ρ(−t). Then ∫ (ρ * F)(x) h(x) dx = ∫ F(x) (ρ̌ * h)(x) dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F ρ h : Rn n → ℝ), Integrable F volume → Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ x, convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x * h x = ∫ x, F x * convolution (fun t ↦ ρ (-t)) h (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x
